environment.description: Kubernetes pod with the following runtime constraints: (1) Container runs with a custom seccomp profile (seccomp-stream-proc.json) that blocks the openat, openat2, and newfstatat syscalls for any path outside /app and /tmp via a conditional BPF filter on the first argument, effectively preventing os.ReadFile from accessing /proc, /etc, or any sensitive path. (2) All environment variables containing secrets are injected via a CSI SecretStore driver volume mounted at /mnt/secrets/ as files rather than as process environment variables — the actual ENV vars AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DATABASE_URL etc. are NOT set in the pod spec. (3) The HSM_SIGNING_KEY_URI references a Thales Luna Network HSM partition accessible only via mTLS with a client cert that the application uses for signing operations — the raw private key never exists in process memory or on any filesystem the container can read. The combination of syscall filtering preventing file reads outside /app|/tmp AND absence of secrets in environment variables means the template injection's env() and readFile() functions return empty strings for all sensitive data.

config.seccomp_profile: seccomp-stream-proc.json with BPF path-conditional openat/openat2/newfstatat filtering
config.secrets_delivery: CSI SecretStore volume at /mnt/secrets (not env vars)
